answer: The shale I would price into every new account is Duolingo streak over one hundred eighty days: a language streak that never broke, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a language streak that never broke takes calendar time as well as money — and the violet is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The zephyr is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk.
